name: Arcane Titan
primary:
A giant arcane titan rises waist-deep from the ground at the aimed spot and fights from there while you keep the channel.
Ultimate channel: just stand still for up to 12 s. Stepping aside breaks the channel and the titan sinks back underground; instant mode does not apply. Needs open sky above the aimed spot.
It picks foes within 20 blocks and, about every 1.5 s, either fires arcane rays at up to 3 foes at once: damage 4 ❤ arcane, instability;
or slams the ground with both fists, which unleashes a rune blast; everyone within 5 blocks takes 5 ❤ arcane, instability and knockback.
self_description:
On you:
